title: A REST read that projects a file field without `id` answers `{id, metadataRefused: true}` for a caller that may read the file
body:
Found by the hotclm app (objectstack-ai/hotclm#19, PR #185) on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0.

**What happens.** `GET /api/v1/data/clm_contract_type?select=template_file`, as an app admin (hotclm `clm.admin`, not the platform admin), answers `template_file: {id, metadataRefused: true}`. The same request with `select=id,template_file` answers the full `{name, size, mimeType, url}`. The platform admin gets the full value either way.

**Reach.** REST and API callers that project narrowly. The Console always selects `id`, so no screen shows this. The verdict looks like it is derived from the parent record, and without `id` in the projection the hydration seems unable to find the parent, so a permitted reader is told the metadata is refused.

**Seam.** The runtime's file-field read expansion (the parent-derived verdict of #22637) → a consumer projecting without `id`.

**Expected.** The verdict does not depend on whether the caller listed `id`: either the hydration fetches the key it needs, or the projection adds it internally and trims it back.

Dedupe: searched metadataRefused / file field / select projection. The nearest are #22637 and #22593 (closed, the rules this follows).
